name: vulnscan
description: Static security scan of a Python file or folder without executing it: hardcoded secrets, eval/exec/pickle.loads, shell=True, SQL string building, weak hashes (MD5/SHA1), unsafe yaml.load, debug=True, and assert-based checks. Findings ranked by severity, report saved to data/vulnscan/. bandit-free AST scan - the code is parsed, never run.
route: vulnerability scan of project folder, scan my python code for security issues, is this code safe, security scan D:/proj
